verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API supports plan-scoped access tokens (figma-docs-48) and its hosted MCP server enforces an OAuth flow with a specific limited scope (`mcp:connect`) rather than full account access (figma-probe-rt-2), showing some least-privilege credentialing for agent connections. However there's no evidence of a granular scope catalog (e.g., read-only vs. write, per-file scoping) for issuing tailored least-privilege tokens to individual agents. Missing for 10: documented fine-grained scope options for REST/PAT tokens, explicit UI/API for creating per-agent restricted credentials, and independent confirmation that scopes can be narrowed beyond org/enterprise plan level.
